SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_no = #{budgetNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT budget_no FROM ( SELECT budget_no FROM project_budget WHERE budget_no LIKE 'BUDGET' || #{dateStr} || '%' ORDER BY budget_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_type = #{budgetType} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_status = #{budgetStatus} ORDER BY budget_end_date ASC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE approval_status = #{approvalStatus} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_manager_id = #{budgetManagerId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE approver_id = #{approverId} ORDER BY approval_date DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE approval_status = 1 ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE approval_status = 2 ORDER BY approval_date DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_status = 2 ORDER BY budget_end_date ASC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_status = 3 ORDER BY budget_end_date DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE used_budget > total_budget ORDER BY (used_budget - total_budget) DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE used_budget / total_budget >= 0.8 AND used_budget <= total_budget ORDER BY (used_budget / total_budget) DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE total_budget >= #{minAmount} ORDER BY total_budget DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_manager_id = #{userId} ORDER BY budget_end_date ASC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY budget_year DESC, budget_quarter DESC, budget_month DESC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_status IN (1, 2) AND DATE(budget_end_date) = DATE(SYSDATE) ORDER BY budget_end_date ASC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_status IN (1, 2) AND budget_end_date BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + 7 ORDER BY budget_end_date ASC

SELECT
FROM project_budget WHERE budget_status IN (1, 2) AND budget_end_date BETWEEN SYSDATE AND SYSDATE + 30 ORDER BY budget_end_date ASC

SELECT budget_year as budgetYear, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(total_budget), 0) as totalBudgetSum, COALESCE(SUM(used_budget), 0) as totalUsedBudget, COALESCE(SUM(remaining_budget), 0) as totalRemainingBudget, COALESCE(AVG(total_budget), 0) as avgTotalBudget, COUNT(CASE WHEN used_budget > total_budget THEN 1 END) as overBudgetCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN budget_status = 3 THEN 1 END) as completedCount FROM project_budget WHERE budget_year = #{year} GROUP BY budget_year
